jobs.occupation: Working Student (d/f/m) Data Engineering, AI & Digital Dashboards (Elektroniker/in - Luftfahrttechnische Systeme)
jobs.description: Job descriptionIn order to support our team within the A320 Family Quality Customer Line, Airbus Operations is looking for aWorking Student (d/f/m) Data Engineering, AI & Digital DashboardsAre you passionate about data analytics, interactive dashboards, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and modern digital tools? Do you want to apply your analytical mindset and technical curiosity directly within the dynamic environment of an international aerospace group? Then come on board to help us build innovative digital solutions, explore AI-driven capabilities, and streamline work processes across our global sites! We are looking for a motivated Master's student (d/f/m) to join our team for 15–18 hours per week.- Location: Hamburg-Finkenwerder- Start Date: 15/January/2027- Duration: 12 monthsYou will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €18.53 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.Definition working studentWorking students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.Your location: Hamburg FinkenwerderYou will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.Your Role in the Team: Step right into the heartbeat of commercial aviation! As part of the transnational A320 Family Quality Customer Line, you operate directly where our end product meets the global customer interface across Hamburg, Toulouse, Mobile, and Tianjin. In this high-stakes environment, your work directly impacts the final delivery of world-class aircraft to international customers.You will be the catalyst driving our digital transformation roadmap—engineering robust data pipelines, building interactive quality dashboards, and leveraging AI and modern digital tools to support and automate workflows. If you want to see your digital solutions and automation tools directly shape operational routines and real aircraft delivery, this is your runway. We give you full ownership and autonomy to turn your ideas into live, high-visibility deliverables.Your Benefits:- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- Work with modern/diversified technologies.- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Your Tasks and Responsibilities:- Build Dashboards & Data Guardianship: Build interactive Skywise applications (Workshop, Slate, Contour) and backend data models. Serve as a data guardian for the team by creating and maintaining clear documentation for the data architecture and analytics landscape.- Streamline & Automate Workflows: Identify process optimization opportunities and transform them into modern, automated reporting and tools using Skywise, Google Workspace, and smart AI-assisted capabilities.- Evaluate Digital Feasibility: Assess new feature requests for data availability and technical feasibility in Skywise to help prioritize the team’s development roadmap.- Present Prototypes & Demo Solutions: Run live demonstrations of working Skywise tools in management reviews and capture user feedback to continuously improve usability.- Drive Site Adoption: Coordinate pre-release trial runs and deliver hands-on user training to onboard teams across our global sites.Desired skills and qualifications:- Education: Currently enrolled fulltime as Master's student (d/f/m) in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science, Data Engineering, or a comparable technical field.- Language Skills: Fluent English skills (C1) are mandatory; German and/or French language skills are a plus.- Core Technical Foundations: Practical experience in programming with SQL, Python, and Apps Script, combined with an interest in data modeling concepts and AI-assisted tools (e.g. Prompt Engineering).- Google Workspace: Familiarity with Google Workspace tools for reporting and digital workflow integration.- Familiarity with Skywise / Palantir Foundry—or experience in relevant data & UI modules (e.g. Contour, Workshop, Slate or SQL data modeling)—is a strong plus**.**- Soft Skills: A proactive and structured self-starter with a helping-oriented mindset, dedicated to supporting end-users and solving real stakeholder needs. Excellent communication skills, critical thinking, and a sharp eye for high data quality.Are you interested and ready to take off with us? Please upload the following documents in English**: cover letter, CV, relevant certificates, and current certificate of enrollmen**t.This role requires an awareness of potential compliance risks and integrity in conduct. Both are essential prerequisites for the success, good reputation, and sustainable growth of our company.This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growthBy submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Account Executive (gn) – Italy & EMEA (Technical-Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Your Role at ProemionMachine data now decides how fast OEMs resolve service cases, improve their machines and build new revenue streams. Proemion delivers the complete telematics solution from a single source: hardware, connectivity and software, integrated directly into the machine and operated securely.Our customers are OEMs in construction, agriculture, material handling and municipal equipment. From our headquarters in Fulda we work worldwide and are steadily growing our business across EMEA. For the Italian market, we are looking for you.We are looking for an experienced Account Executive (gn) for the EMEA region with a focus on Italy to strengthen our sales team full-time , starting immediately . The position is 100% remote in Germany – of course, you are always welcome at our headquarters in Fulda.In return, we offer you• Fully remote within Germany, with flexible working hours• English-first organisation and an international team• Real decision-making freedom, no micromanagement, short lines to the leadership team• Thorough onboarding, individual training and 1:1s focused on your development• Childcare allowance, benefits card and award-winning corporate health management• When you visit Fulda: a modern, open office with lounges, table football and pool, team events, drinks, cereal and fresh fruitYour RoleYour mandate is new business in Italy and the wider EMEA region: you open OEM accounts Proemion does not serve today and take them through to a signed contract and the first series project.• You build your own pipeline of target accounts, from first outreach to close• You get deep into your customers' organisations and bring engineering, service, aftermarket, IT and procurement to the same table• You shape the technical solution together with our pre-sales team and win decision-makers over with the business case• You own proposal, negotiation and close• After rollout you hand the customer over to account management and customer success in a structured way, and stay close for follow-on business• You represent Proemion at trade fairs, conferences and on customer sites, and bring market feedback back into the companyYou report to the VP Sales EMEA and work closely with pre-sales, marketing and product management.Your Skills• Several years of new-business experience selling complex technical B2B solutions, ideally to OEMs in the off-highway sector• Comfortable with sales cycles of 12 to 24 months and multiple decision-makers on the customer side• Familiar with recurring revenue models such as subscriptions or service contracts• Technical understanding and the appetite to go deep into machines, electronics and data architectures• Confident with a CRM, ideally Salesforce• Business-fluent Italian and English; German is a plus, not a requirement• Independent, results-driven and disciplined enough to build a pipeline remotely• Willingness to travel within EMEA, with a focus on ItalyAbout usWe are a fast-growing international industrial tech company at the forefront of the IoT/Telematics revolution with headquarters in Fulda. Outside of Germany, we have offices in the USA and South Korea, as well as numerous colleagues working remotely for us worldwide. With you, we want to continuously develop the company to the next level.With us, you can move things forward. There are short decision-making processes and a lot of creative freedom for you. Our corporate culture is characterized by internationality, diversity and agility as well as by a hands-on mentality.We value you as an individual, along with the skills and talents you bring. We would welcome the diversity you add to our team.

jobs.occupation: IT System Engineer – Infrastructure (IT-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Universal Investment is on its way to becoming Europe's leading fund services platform and Super ManCo. We have provided innovative fund solutions for asset managers and institutional investors since 1968. From our offices in Frankfurt, Krakow, Luxembourg, Dublin, Paris, Singapore and Stockholm, we continue to expand internationally. We are currently looking for entrepreneurial people who want to grow and share in the profits of our success.We are looking for a hands-on IT System Engineer to support the daily operation, stability, and continuous improvement of our enterprise IT infrastructure in Frankfurt. This is a strongly operational role focused on ensuring high availability, reliable backup operations, and stable storage and virtualization platforms within a regulated environment.Your tasks and responsibilities:- ·         Provide operational support and ensure the stable day-to-day running of server, storage, backup, and virtualization infrastructure.- ·         Administer and maintain Microsoft Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policies, file services, and permissions.- ·         Deliver 2nd and 3rd level support, troubleshoot complex incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term solutions.- ·         Manage NetApp storage platforms, including provisioning, performance monitoring, capacity management, replication, and high-availability configurations.- ·         Administer Commvault backup and recovery services, ensuring successful backups, restore readiness, and disaster recovery support.- ·         Support VMware vSphere and/or Hyper-V environments, including VM provisioning, lifecycle management, performance monitoring, and high-availability solutions.- ·         Perform patch management, security hardening, system monitoring, and performance optimization across infrastructure platforms.- ·         Coordinate infrastructure maintenance activities, vendor engagements, firmware upgrades, and post-change validation.- ·         Work within ITIL-based Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes while maintaining accurate technical documentation.- Ensure compliance with audit, security, and regulatory requirements, ideally within a financial services or other regulated environment.Your skills and experience:- Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; alternatively, completed vocational IT training with relevant professional experience.- Minimum 5 years of experience in IT infrastructure, system engineering, or a similar technical environment.- Proven track record supporting and maintaining enterprise-scale infrastructure and business-critical systems.- Strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Windows Server, NetApp ONTAP storage, Commvault backup solutions, and VMware and/or Hyper-V environments.- Experience working with production systems, high-availability architectures, and disaster recovery concepts.- Good understanding of ITIL-based service management processes, including Incident, Problem, and Change Management.- Fluent in both German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.- Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities, with a structured and methodical approach to problem-solving.- Service-oriented, reliable, and able to work effectively in a regulated and process-driven environment.- Comfortable collaborating with technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders across the organisation.What we offer:- A dynamic and engaging workplace filled with exciting challenges- In-depth exposure to the European fund industry to enhance your expertise and career growth- A supportive and friendly atmosphere with a diverse, goal-oriented team- An empowering role that emphasizes independent work- Attractive perks, including a Deutschlandticket, discounts at our office canteen and various health benefits- A flexible hybrid working modelErgänzende Informationen:Nur schwerbehinderte oder ihnen gleichgestellte Personen
